title: Geospatial Mobility Analytics for Public Transit Optimization
problem: Japan's transit operators needed data-driven insights from large-scale GPS data (2M+ trajectory records) to optimize bus scheduling and reduce inefficient off-peak operations.
actions: Extracted and aggregated 2M+ GPS trajectory records using SQL and Python
Built interactive geospatial dashboards using Kepler.gl and MovingPandas
Analyzed mobility patterns to identify network inefficiencies and trends
Presented insights to government stakeholders to inform scheduling decisions
results: Reduced off-peak trips by 30% (framing variants: optimized bus schedules; empowered government stakeholders to cut inefficient off-peak operations)
example_bullets: Pioneered interactive geospatial dashboards (Kepler.gl, MovingPandas) from 2M GPS records to optimize bus schedules and reveal mobility trends in Japan’s transit system; insights shared with government stakeholders reduced off-peak trips by 30%.

Pioneered interactive geospatial visualizations (Kepler.gl) by extracting and aggregating 2M+ GPS records using SQL and Python; revealed mobility trends in Japan’s transit system that empowered government stakeholders to reduce off-peak trips by 30%.
harvested_bullets: Analyzed over 2M GPS trajectories using SQL and Python, generating interactive geospatial dashboards with Kepler.gl to visualize mobility patterns and inform stakeholders, reducing off-peak transit trips by 30%.

Produced interactive geospatial dashboards from 2M+ GPS trajectory records using SQL/Python with Kepler.gl and MovingPandas; synthesized mobility trends for government stakeholders to inform schedule changes and reduce off-peak trips by 30%.

Processed 2M+ GPS trajectory records using SQL and Python to build geospatial dashboards, communicating mobility insights to government stakeholders that optimized transit scheduling and reduced off-peak trips by 30%.

title: Production Address Standardization Pipeline for DHL Turkey
problem: Noisy, unstructured real-world address data for DHL Turkey reduced routing robustness and downstream operational reliability.
actions: Fine-tuned BERT/RoBERTa NER models to extract structured address entities from noisy text
Engineered and deployed a production ML pipeline for entity extraction
Built CI/CD workflows, unit tests, and Git-based version control processes
Standardized extracted entities for integration with downstream routing systems
results: Improved data quality and downstream routing robustness
example_bullets: Deployed an end-to-end AI-driven solution to fine-tune BERT/RoBERTa NLP models for Named Entity Recognition, standardizing logistics address data with 98% extraction accuracy and enhancing routing reliability.

Engineered production ML pipeline for DHL Turkey by fine‑tuning BERT/RoBERTa NER to standardize noisy address data; built CI/CD, and Git workflows; 98% entity extraction accuracy; improved data quality and downstream routing robustness.
harvested_bullets: Fine-tuned BERT/RoBERTa NER models and deployed an end-to-end address standardization pipeline for DHL Turkey; added CI/CD, unit tests, and Git workflows to harden releases; reached 98% entity extraction accuracy.

Engineered a data standardization pipeline using a fine-tuned NLP model to structure noisy logistics address data, supporting data governance initiatives and improving downstream data quality with 98% entity extraction accuracy.

Fine-tuned BERT and RoBERTa models to build a production NLP pipeline for DHL, standardizing noisy address data with 98% extraction accuracy and significantly enhancing downstream logistics routing reliability.

title: Large-Scale Vehicle Routing Optimization for 7-Eleven Deliveries
problem: Manual logistics planning for 10K daily 7-Eleven deliveries was time-consuming and suboptimal under cost, service-level, and capacity constraints, with ambiguous requirements.
actions: Modeled vehicle routing problems (VRP) under cost, service-level, and capacity constraints
Applied clustering (including agglomerative clustering) to improve route structure
Automated route planning for 10K daily deliveries in partnership with Operations
Conducted offline evaluations comparing routing and ML variants
Tracked KPIs including planning latency, cost per route, and service-level adherence
Built Tableau dashboards to monitor planned vs. actual route performance
Diagnosed route variances to identify bottlenecks and inform schedule adjustments
results: Improved cost efficiency by 8% (framing variants: 8% cost savings)
Improved on-time delivery by 10% through dashboard-driven schedule adjustments
example_bullets: Automated route planning for 10K daily 7-Eleven deliveries using vehicle-routing optimization (VRP) and agglomerative clustering, in partnership with Operations, achieving 8% cost savings and a 70% reduction in planning time.

Designed Tableau dashboards to monitor route optimization performance; diagnosed variances between planned vs. actual routes to pinpoint bottlenecks, enabling the operations team to adjust schedules and improve on-time delivery by 10%.

Analyzed inefficiencies in manual logistics planning for 10K daily 7-Eleven deliveries by modeling tradeoffs between cost, service level, and capacity under operational constraints, reducing planning time by 70% and costs by 8%.
harvested_bullets: Modeled vehicle routing optimization for 10K daily 7-Eleven deliveries under cost, service-level, and capacity constraints; partnered with Operations to evaluate variants and operationalize routing automation; cut planning time 70%.

Optimized route planning for 10K daily deliveries by applying agglomerative clustering and vehicle-routing algorithms in Python, modeling complex operational constraints to reduce logistics planning time by 70% and decrease costs by 8%.

Constructed interactive Tableau dashboards to deliver business intelligence on logistics operations, analyzing planned vs. actual route performance to identify bottlenecks and support improving on-time delivery by 10%.

title: Automated Operational Monitoring and Slack Alerting System
problem: Client-reported system performance issues required reactive investigation, with customer support and engineers manually coordinating root-cause analysis, consuming ~4 hours daily and delaying response time.
actions: Architected automated operational monitoring workflows using Python and Windmill
Designed a Slack-based alerting system to surface daily planning performance metrics in real time
Implemented rule-based data validation checks to proactively detect system anomalies
Automated daily planning performance reporting to increase cross-team transparency
results: Reduced reactive support workload by 4 hours daily (framing variants: eliminated 4 hours of daily manual investigation; reduced support time from ~4 hours to real time)
Improved issue detection speed through proactive KPI visibility
example_bullets: Architected a Python/Windmill-based operational monitoring system with Slack-integrated KPI alerts and automated data validation checks, eliminating 4 hours of daily manual investigation effort.

Designed a proactive performance reporting framework that centralized daily planning metrics in Slack, accelerating cross-team issue triage and reducing reactive escalation workload by 4 hours per day.

Created an automated Slack bot using the workflow automation platform Windmill to deliver real-time task status, performance metrics, and data-validation alerts, reducing support time from 4 hours to real time.
harvested_bullets: Architected a Python-based operational monitoring system with Slack-integrated KPI alerts and automated data validation checks, eliminating 4 hours of daily manual investigation effort for the team.

Designed a proactive monitoring system using Windmill and Slack to automate KPI alerts and data validation checks, which streamlined cross-team issue triage and eliminated 4 hours of daily manual investigation.
